contexts.text: He is then introduced into Heaven.
They brought in Lot to themselves into the house () = that the Lord protects those who are in the good of charity... They who are in good are introduced into Heaven...
(Truths not genuine) serve as a means of introducing genuine truths; and when these have been introduced...
This bitter sap is a means of introducing the sweet.
Foods are introduced by the delight of appetite... but the foods which are introduced do not all enter the life; but some serve for... introducing into the vessels.

The soul... introduces by the delight which is of desire, and by the good which is of affection; but the things it introduces are not all such as to become the good of life; but some serve... for opening and introducing.
The truth there is at first is not truth... but still it serves as a means of introducing genuine truths and goods. AC 3974:2, Signified.
The good represented by Laban... is useful to the genuine truths and goods... AC 3986:end. AC 3991. AC 4063. AC 4063:2. AC 4145:2. AC 4145:end.
Like (that) in the earliest fruits by which the juice is introduced...
Each age has its delights, and by these man is successively introduced into those of the following age.

Middle goods and delights are nothing else than such Societies, which are applied to man by the Lord, in order that by means of them he may be introduced to spiritual and celestial goods and truths... AC 4077:2. AC 4110:2.
These Societies... served the Lord for this use, - to introduce Himself into the knowledge of such good...
These loves were the first introducers (of truths)...
Scientifics... are always introduced by some affection...
That truths were introduced thither into the Natural. Signified.
The first introduction into the good which is from the Celestial of the Spiritual. Signified.
For the Spiritual man is introduced through scientifics into truths, and through truths into good.
Thus is the man introduced into Societies of Angels which are more interior; and in those Societies into which he has once been introduced he remains.
At last... they were introduced into the Land of Canaan.
They who believe that salvation is only introduction into Heaven from mercy... AC 7186:3.
Man is then introduced into Heaven, which is represented by the introduction of the sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan.
They who believe that they can be introduced into Heaven no matter in what sins they may have been... AC 7317:2.
The state of their elevation into Heaven was represented by the introduction into the Land of Canaan. AC 7932:end.
When Jehovah shall have brought thee in to the Land of Canaan () = the region of Heaven occupied by those who are in evil and falsity.
That they were not yet prepared for introduction into Heaven. Signified, Explained.
Thou shalt bring them in () = elevation.
Thence man as to his spirit is introduced more interiorly into Heaven...
The posterior state was represented by their introduction into the Land of Canaan.
The Jordan... signified introduction into the Church, or Heaven, which is effected by means of the Knowledges of truth and good, thus by means of truths from the Word.
By means of the truths of faith man is introduced to the good of charity.
The introduction of the sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan represented the like as this second feast... namely, the implantation of truth in good... AC 9294:end.
Introduction by Him into Heaven according to the good of life and of faith. Signified.
For by the introduction of the sons of Israel into that Land was represented the introduction of the faithful into Heaven.
For to prepare Heaven is to prepare those who are to be introduced into Heaven...
For man is then introduced through truth to good... but when he is in good he is in Heaven, thus has been introduced to the Lord.
Therefore, they who are in the good of love to the Lord are introduced to Him in Heaven... In like manner they who are in the good of love towards the neighbour...
Introduction into (the Ultimate) Heaven. Signified.
A gate = communication and introduction.
For no one is introduced into Heaven unless he has been prepared. Explained.
For they insisted that they should be introduced into the Land of Canaan.
Afterwards, as (the infant) is perfected in intelligence and wisdom, he is introduced into Heaven...
By means of the Knowledges of good and truth (the infants) are successively introduced (into the angelic state).
By means of pleasant and delightful things they are introduced into the goods of innocence and charity.
Through intelligence of truth and wisdom of good (infants in Heaven) are introduced into the angelic life...
They begin to infest him... which is done by introduction more interiorly and deeply into Hell.
By (the Holy Supper) he is conjoined with the Lord and introduced into Heaven.
Conjunction with the Lord is also introduction into Heaven.
Having twelve gates = all the Knowledges of truth and good there, through which man is introduced into the Church.
Every man who has longed for Heaven... is after death introduced into the joys of his imagination. CL 5-9.
There was heard a voice from Heaven... Choose out ten... and introduce them to us...
As man... is introduced into eternal life through the Church...
That the first use of baptism is introduction into the Christian Church...
The Jordan = introduction into the Church.
In the Heavens infants are introduced through baptism into the Christian Heaven.
That... as baptism is an introduction into the Church, so the Holy Supper is an introduction into Heaven.
They who die in infancy or childhood... are introduced by the Lord through baptism...
But infants and children born outside the Christian Church are introduced by another medium than baptism into the Heaven appointed for their religion...
Those who asked to be introduced into Heaven...
Paul wants to be an introducer...
To bring in home the afflicted exiles () = to amend and restore those who are in falsities and thence in grief.
I will bring them in upon the mountain of My holiness () = that He will endow them with the good of love.
Nothing else was signified by the introduction of the sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan... AE 730:31. AE 730:36.
By this miracle is signified the introduction of the faithful into the Church, and through the Church into Heaven.
Through His Divine truths the Lord introduces the faithful into the Church and into Heaven.
